name: gh_issue_update
description: Update an issue's title, body, state, assignee, or labels; closing sets closed_at (PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number})

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

issue_number.description: The number that identifies the issue.

state.description: The open or closed state of the issue. Can be one of: open, closed.

assignee.description: Username to assign to this issue.

labels.description: Labels to set on this issue, as a comma separated list or array of label names (replaces existing labels).
